decision: The original supervisor was invoked once with the exact admitted controls and refused before source scope creation or any test phase. The inode mismatch is explained by the official Node v24.22.1 signed64 BigIntStats construction. The two retained raw values represent the same64 inode bits. Recommend a narrowly scoped, explicit and range-checked unsigned normalization at the cross-language Node inode comparison in a fresh reviewed scope. This advisory authors no source/control/helper and authorizes no replay.

refusalControlFlow.qualification: The initial Node inode comparison throws before its later uid/gid/timestamp comparisons, byte-count and digest checks. Thus the supervisor did not admit complete Node identity. Its own nodeBefore result is absent. External complete pre/post Node metadata and full SHA256 are separately retained and unchanged. The observed original supervisor exit is1; no test child or group was created on this path.

nodeRepresentation.interpretation: The negative Node value is the signed interpretation of the same high-bit-set64-bit inode represented positively by the retained Python metadata. It is not a floating-point rounding difference and does not require changing the unsigned inode pin or the Node binary.
nodeRepresentation.causalStatus: Supported by complete pinned upstream construction path and the original observed runtime failure; no additional runtime probe or rebuild was performed.

sourceFacts.meaning: The Unix fallback copies the native stat inode directly into uv_stat_t after lstat.
The Linux statx path directly copies stx_ino into the same unsigned field.
lstatSync passes the bigint option into the native binding; synchronous LStat obtains uv_stat_t and calls FillGlobalStatsArray.
The bigint stats buffer is AliasedBigInt64Array, whose native element type is int64_t and JavaScript view is BigInt64Array.
FillStatsArray casts each stat field to NativeT, including st_ino, and stores that signed int64_t value. The bigint branch returns the signed JavaScript array view.
getStatsFromBinding reads index7 from BigInt64Array, passes it to BigIntStats, and StatsBase assigns it directly to this.ino. There is no unsigned correction on this path.

officialDocumentation.meaning: bigint:true makes numeric fs.Stats values BigInt and adds nanosecond properties; the docs alone do not promise unsigned inode representation.
stats.ino is the filesystem-specific inode number, with number or bigint type.
BigInt64Array uses64-bit two's-complement signed integer elements.
BigInt.asUintN returns the argument modulo2 raised to the requested bit width.
BigInt.asIntN converts the residue to the corresponding signed range; this is the exact inverse on the validated64-bit domains.

recommendedMinimalRule.scope: Only the cross-language Node inode equality against the unsigned Python-derived immutable binding pin. Preserve generic metadata's raw inode and existing same-runtime before/after comparisons.
recommendedMinimalRule.inputRepresentation: Exact canonical decimal strings parsed as BigInt, never Number; retain the original raw Node decimal separately.
recommendedMinimalRule.rawDomain: Require -2^63 <= rawNodeInode < 2^63 for this pinned Node signed64 path.
recommendedMinimalRule.normalization: For an in-range signed raw value, leave nonnegative values unchanged and add18446744073709551616 exactly once to negative values. This is BigInt.asUintN at width64, applied only after validating the domains.
recommendedMinimalRule.comparison: Require the resulting canonical unsigned64 inode to equal the unchanged exact expected pin. Keep the signed raw value and the canonical unsigned value together in retained Node identity evidence.
recommendedMinimalRule.inverse: The corresponding signed64 interpretation of the expected unsigned pin must be the exact raw value; the arithmetic already holds for this refusal.
recommendedMinimalRule.preservation: Keep the exact Node path, realpath, no-symlink and regular-file requirements, mode0755, device27, exact full byte count126939688, SHA25661ab14cd750fc24d5db53490ec5fc40f756e4b6e136b78cf7004265471d9bd1d, uid/gid, mtimeNs and ctimeNs comparisons unchanged. Preserve all per-phase and outer identity checks.
recommendedMinimalRule.noInformationLoss: On the checked signed64 domain the mapping is a bijection onto unsigned64. The nonnegative half maps to the lower half and the negative half maps to the upper half. No two admitted raw values collide, and all64 inode bits are checked.
recommendedMinimalRule.reject: Reject noncanonical or out-of-range input, mismatch of normalized inode, or any other identity mismatch. Do not apply modulo to arbitrary-width integers without range validation, use absolute value, round through Number, rewrite the pin from a fresh observation, omit inode, or normalize unrelated signed timestamps.
recommendedMinimalRule.unchangedOtherScope: No changes to test/source bodies, package, phase inventories, budgets, original process ownership/cleanup, raw output evidence or broader qualification. No Node substitution, extra version invocation, or new exploratory process is needed for this source diagnosis.

spentAndQualification.freshScopeRequirement: A fresh narrowly reviewed R1/control scope is required before any corrected original attempt. Retain the old refusal and stage; no same-attempt retry is selected. This is the existing task's fresh-scope requirement, not an added approval flow.
